final: WITH j AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS pid, p.bats AS bats FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON CAST(ma.player_id AS TEXT) = CAST(p.player_id AS TEXT)), g AS (SELECT pid, bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY pid, bats), bh AS (SELECT bats, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g GROUP BY bats), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS grand FROM bh) SELECT bh.bats, bh.total, CAST(bh.total AS REAL) / overall.grand AS ratio FROM bh JOIN overall ON overall.grand IS NOT NULL
